shortDescription: Create, update, destroy, resume, suspend, and reboot a Ionos CUBE virtual machine.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: assign_public_ip
options.description: This will assign the machine to the public LAN. If no LAN exists with public Internet access it is created.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: The availability zone in which the server should be provisioned. For CUBE and GPU servers, the only value accepted is 'AUTO'. For servers with Confidential Computing enabled, this field is immutable once the server has been created — update requests attempting to change it will be rejected.

options.name: boot_cdrom
options.description: Reference to a CD-ROM used as boot device. Forbidden when the server has a volume whose image is a Confidential Computing image: such a server must boot from that volume and cannot boot from a CD-ROM. On servers with Confidential Computing enabled this field is immutable — update requests attempting to change it will be rejected.

options.name: boot_volume
options.description: Reference to a volume used as boot device. If the server has a volume with a Confidential Computing image, that volume — and only that volume — is eligible as the boot volume. Setting `bootVolume` to any other volume is rejected. If `bootVolume` is not provided on a server that has a Confidential Computing volume, that volume is automatically selected as the boot device. options.name: bus
options.description: The bus type for the volume.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of virtual machines to create.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The datacenter to provision this virtual machine.

options.name: disk_type
options.description: The disk type for the volume.

options.name: image
options.description: The image alias or ID for creating the virtual machine.

options.name: image_password
options.description: Password set for the administrative user.

options.name: instance_ids
options.description: list of instance ids. Should only contain one ID if renaming in update state

options.name: lan
options.description: The ID or name of the LAN you wish to add the servers to (can be a string or a number).

options.name: location
options.description: The datacenter location. Use only if you want to create the Datacenter or else this value is ignored.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the  resource.

options.name: nat
options.description: Boolean value indicating if the private IP address has outbound access to the public Internet.

options.name: nic_ips
options.description: The list of IPS for the NIC.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: remove_boot_volume
options.description: Remove the bootVolume of the virtual machine you're destroying.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: Public SSH keys allowing access to the virtual machine.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: template_uuid
options.description: The ID of the template for creating CUBE or GPU servers. If a template has GPU cards assigned, then it can only be used to create GPU servers, otherwise it can only be used for CUBE servers. The available templates can be found on the templates resource.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: user_data
options.description: The cloud-init configuration for the volume as base64 encoded string.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
